summary: Iteration 15 features (per-consultant payouts + clients.whatsapp + accounts.account_number removed) verified. Backend: 26/26 pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_payouts.py (rewritten from tenant-level to per-user model). Verified: (1) accounts.account_number field is stripped from POST/PUT on /api/data/accounts (create by client returns doc without account_number; migration set count to 0 in Mongo); (2) clients.whatsapp field is saved encrypted (stored ciphertext != plaintext) and returned decrypted through the API; (3) GET/PUT /api/payouts/bank works for admin AND consultant, client 403; validation rejects 6/8-digit account_number, ASCII holder_kana, bad account_type; empty codes ok; encrypted at rest on users.payout_bank.enc; tenants.payout_bank removed by startup migration; (4) /api/auth/me returns payout_bank_registered boolean and never exposes payout_bank; (5) card_enabled per client: true when consultant has bank, false in tenant B; POST /api/stripe/checkout/invoice returns 409 when the client's consultant has no bank, and passes gating (200 or Stripe 400) when set; (6) GET /api/platform/payouts returns {payees, history} grouped per payee_id with payee_name/payee_email/tenant_name/bank/items/total; POST /api/platform/payouts/{user_id} returns 409 for no-bank user, creates payout doc with SENT status + masked bank + payee_id, marks payments.payout_settled/payee_id, and the consultant sees the new payout id in GET /api/payouts history; (7) sign_notify._deliver falls back to clients.whatsapp (digits only) and writes a WHATSAPP message_log entry with the fallback phone when the user has no whatsapp_phone (used WA_URL monkeypatch to an unreachable endpoint since WHATSAPP_SERVICE_URL is empty in preview → FAILED entry with correct fallback phone confirms path). Frontend: verified that (a) the payout-gate modal opens for admin & consultant B (no bank), (b) does NOT open for client user, (c) the /settings 'payout_bank' tab is labelled 'カード決済の受取口座' and is NOT inside 請求者情報 (verified: card is absent when 請求者情報 tab is active), (d) the /clients form triggers via 新規登録 button. However a CRITICAL frontend bug was found (see below) that prevents the PayoutGate save button from being visible/clickable via normal user interaction, which cascades to blocking navigation to Settings/Platform/Clients while the gate is open.

ui_bugs.issue: The DialogContent uses className='[&>button]:hidden' to hide Radix's default close 'X' button. But BankForm bare renders its fields inside a React fragment (<>...<Button data-testid='pb-save'>...) which makes the Button a *direct child* of DialogContent. The Tailwind arbitrary selector [&>button]:hidden therefore also hides the pb-save submit button (verified: computed style display:none, offsetParent null, height 0). Consequence: a non-demo admin/consultant with no registered bank sees the gate modal but cannot see or click the 保存 button — they are locked out of the entire app until an operator saves the bank via API. Confirmed via a JS-forced .click() which does successfully save (toast '保存しました' and gate closes as designed).

critical_code_review_comments: payouts.card_clients does not filter users by role — a client user that happens to have payout_bank set would be treated as a consultant. Currently /payouts/bank is restricted to admin+consultant so this is defensive-only, but adding {'role': {'$in': ['admin','consultant']}} to the users query would be safer.

payouts._payee falls back to clients.consultant_id at read time when payments.payee_id is unset. Correct for historical STRIPE payments predating this change, but consider a one-time migration to backfill payee_id on old payments — otherwise every /platform/payouts request runs N extra client lookups.

payouts.mark_sent still does {"$set": {payout_settled: i['net']}}, overwriting the value. Now that pending is per-payee, a payment split across payees is impossible, but if the same payment ever needs settling twice (e.g. refund-then-reversal), $inc would be safer. Non-blocking.

rca of the issue: PayoutGate bug RCA: Tailwind arbitrary variant [&>button]:hidden on DialogContent uses direct-child (>) combinator to hide Radix's built-in close X button. BankForm renders its fields via a React fragment (<>...</>) so the fragment children get flattened and the <Button data-testid='pb-save'> ends up as a direct child of DialogContent. The variant therefore applies to it and to the close-X button alike (display:none). Reproduce: log in as any non-demo admin/consultant with no bank, observe modal missing 保存 button. Mitigation: wrap BankForm output in a plain <div> (or a <form>), or replace [&>button]:hidden with a selector that only targets the auto-injected close button (Radix adds an aria-label='Close' — [&>button[aria-label='Close']]:hidden works). Same issue would recur for any child component with a top-level Button inside DialogContent that uses this variant.
